zh.title: 國防部偵獲8架共機與7艘共艦擾台 7架次越中線
zh.summary: 國防部偵獲共機8架次與共艦7艘；7架共機越海峽中線；國軍嚴密監控應處。
body: 國防部公布最新共機艦動態，統計自2026年9月14日上午6時起至9月15日上午6時止，共計偵獲共機8架次、共艦7艘及公務船2艘，持續在台灣周邊海空域活動。
根據國防部說明，在偵獲的8架次共機中，有7架次逾越台灣海峽中線，分別侵擾北部、西南及東部空域。國軍對此運用任務機艦及岸置飛彈系統，進行嚴密監控與即時應處。
另據本站統計紀錄顯示，前一次於9月14日記錄到的台海周邊動態，包含共機2架次、共艦6艘及公務船2艘。

en.title: Taiwan Detects 8 PLA Aircraft and 7 Naval Vessels Near Island
en.summary: Taiwan MND detects eight PLA aircraft and seven naval ships; seven sorties cross median line.
body: Taiwan's Ministry of National Defense released PLA aircraft and vessel activity statistics, reporting that between 6:00 a.m. on September 14 and 6:00 a.m. on September 15, eight PLA aircraft, seven PLA Navy vessels, and two official ships were detected operating around Taiwan.

According to the ministry, seven of the detected PLA aircraft crossed the median line of the Taiwan Strait, entering the northern, southwestern, and eastern airspace. Taiwan's armed forces deployed combat aircraft, naval vessels, and land-based missile systems to closely monitor and respond to the movements.
According to SKYTICAL database records, the previous report on September 14 recorded two PLA aircraft, six PLA Navy vessels, and two official ships operating near Taiwan.
